_about: Boss data for Maple Wordle. Sources: maplestorywiki.net, Namu Wiki, Bahamut TMS HP table (Oct 2026). Normal/Hard modes use one difficulty per boss (Hard/Chaos > Extreme > Normal > Easy; Gollux = Hell). Extreme mode lists every difficulty as its own entry. hp = sum of all phase HP. level = entry level. Story mode uses the normal pool with unlimited guesses. null = Unknown; hpLabel overrides the HP display (e.g. 300Q+).

rules.numbers: Phases, HP and Entry Lv: green if equal, otherwise an arrow pointing toward the answer. If the guess or the answer is Unknown, the tile is red with no arrow.
rules.text: World, Gender, Region: green if equal, otherwise grey.
rules.hpValues: GMS values are used wherever servers differ.

notes.Zakum: 1 phase; HP = body only (arms don't count)
notes.Gollux: GMS HP, 3 Head phases only. Wiki only lists the 180+ requirement, so every mode uses 180
notes.Cygnus: Removed from KMS in the Overdrive update
notes.Malicia: MSEA added Lian Plateau (Li-an Highlands) in Nov 2025, and her wiki page lists MSEA names and drops. Normal HP from Bahamut (TMS) boss HP table, Jul 2026: P1 49T + inner world 21T, P2 56T, P3 24T, P4 28T. Extreme: known phases total ~149.7Q but Phase 4 is unknown, so shown as 300Q+
notes.Kaling: P1 = 3 perils, P2 = Kaling, P3 = 3 perils + Frenzied Kaling
notes.Limbo: P2 = two separate parts. Extreme: KMST (test server), HP not known yet, roughly 45Q+
notes.Baldrix: Extreme: KMST (test server), HP not known yet, roughly 50Q+
notes.Kai: Challenger World seasonal boss; World set to Other (Nexus Tower)
notes.Meilin: Challenger World Season 4 boss (Namu Wiki). One HP bar split into 2 phases: she changes form at 50% HP
notes.Balrog: Only Easy mode exists; HP = body + 2 extra parts
notes.Yakuza Boss: Showa Town (Zipangu): in JMS, GMS and MSEA only; entry level = Showa Town quest requirement
notes.Frenzied Gigatoad: Ninja Castle (Zipangu): in JMS, GMS and MSEA only; GMS HP (other servers: 1.7B); entry level = Ninja Castle requirement
notes.Reina: Apostle of Darmoor, fought in an Arteria quest; difficulty, phases, HP and entry level unknown
notes.Julieta: Removed (Monad). No HP/level/phases on any wiki
notes.Cross: Removed JMS/TMS boss. No HP/level/phases on any wiki
notes.Inferno Wolf: Bounty portal boss: Normal Lv 10-199, Chaos Lv 200-259, Extreme Lv 260+. HP from Namu Wiki
notes.Gerand Darmoor: God-King of the High Flora; no boss fight yet. Entry level assumed 300+ (highest in the game)
notes.Havoc: Apostle of Darmoor; no boss fight found on MapleWiki or Namu Wiki (story character only)
